name: household
description: Budgeting with YNAB, savings research, free game giveaways, cloud storage organization, and Google Drive journals and trackers.

interface.shortDescription: Budgeting, savings, free games, file organization, and Google Drive journals for home life
interface.longDescription: Household collects skills for running a home: categorize YNAB transactions and learn from your corrections, find savings on bills and subscriptions, claim free-to-keep game giveaways, file loose files in your cloud storage under rules learned from your corrections, and keep Google Drive journals, their photos, and a Drive Markdown issue tracker.
